title: H3748 (126th General Assembly): Pointing a firearm

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2025-01-15; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess126_2025-2026/prever/3748_20250115.htm (LegiScan doc 3058364))
provenance.note: Introduced version (2025-01-15); no passage vote on record. The words "present or" are struck from the offence, so merely presenting a firearm is no longer covered.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 16-23-410): It is unlawful for a person to point at another person a loaded or unloaded firearm.
Section 1 (Section 16-23-410): A person who violates the provisions of this section is guilty of a felony and, upon conviction, must be fined in the discretion of the court or imprisoned not more than five years.
Section 1 (Section 16-23-410): This section must not be construed to abridge the right of self-defense or to apply to theatricals or like performances.
